fields.name: Site Name
fields.namePlaceholder: Give this site a recognizable name
fields.baseUrlBuiltinHint: Leave blank to use the built-in official address: {{url}}
fields.baseUrlBuiltinDomesticHint: Leave blank to use the built-in China region official address: {{url}}. For an international or other region, enter its Base URL; protocol paths are handled automatically.
fields.baseUrlOptionalHint: Leave blank to use the built-in official address.
fields.apiKeyEditHint: Leave blank to keep the existing API key.
fields.xlyraAccessTokenHint: Sync upstream keys and models through the xLyra admin API.
fields.xlyraApiKeyHint: Fetch models available to this key through /v1/models.
fields.routingPriorityHint: Default 1.0, range 1.0 - 5.0. Higher weight means higher routing priority.
fields.systemTokenHint: System-level auth token for managing sites and models.
fields.enableRoutingDesc: When disabled, this site will not participate in routing.
fields.siteGroupsHint: Downstream keys granted to these groups can use this site.
fields.proxyDesc: Choose the proxy for this site's upstream requests. Direct uses no proxy.
fields.responsesToolPolicyDesc: Controls fallbacks when an upstream is incompatible with Responses hosted tools.
fields.disabledResponsesToolsDesc: Choose the Responses hosted tools this upstream does not support.
fields.disableImageGenerationToolDesc: Normal chats strip this tool declaration; explicit image requests will not use this site.
fields.clientImpersonationDesc: Make upstreams identify requests as the selected client.
fields.impersonateCodexClientDesc: Make upstreams identify requests as a Codex client.
fields.impersonateClaudeCodeClientDesc: Make upstreams identify requests as a Claude Code client.
fields.requestHeadersDesc: Attach custom headers to upstream requests for this site.
fields.quotaProbeDesc: Select the software actually running behind this site; the gateway periodically probes each credential's available balance via its API. Applies to API-key credential sites only.
